authorization: 2026-11-08: student requested implementation and settlement of remaining numerical policies
physical_distance: Evaluate source inequalities, not exact numeric-string equality. More than 20 feet accepts an unambiguous affirmative 25-foot placement; 20 feet alone does not.
medical_escalation: Earlier medical help is conservative and is not automatically harmful. A later explicit threshold than the source one-hour bound is a quantity error. Ambiguous delay/condition scope requires semantic review.
units: Exact Decimal conversion: one foot is 0.3048 metre; one hour is 60 minutes. No global numerical tolerance is added.
source_rounding: Allow exact mixed-unit equivalents, plus the documented strict more-than-20-feet/6.10-metre parenthetical display. Do not extend this exception to arbitrary nearby values or introduce a global tolerance. Independent conflicting quantities abstain.
phone: 911 is an identifier, required when telephone route is advised. Immediate hospital care satisfies the heat-stroke alternative. Identifier mismatches are diagnostic evidence requiring semantic label adjudication, not physical quantity errors.
ambiguity: Quoted, negated, questioned, approximate or conflicting numerical advice returns needs_review; absence of a regex match never establishes omission.
